    mode = sys.argv[1]
    if mode == 'red':
        archived_red()
        return
    if mode == 'self-test':
        self_test()
        for effort in ('medium', 'high'):
            for bound in ('allowed', 'count', 'cost', 'closed'):
                check = CT37Ledger()
                check.state.update(status='running', request_limit=20, usd_limit=.10)
                if bound == 'count': check.state['request_limit'] = 0
                if bound == 'cost': check.state['reservation_usd'] = .099
                if bound == 'closed': check.state['status'] = 'closed'
                request = httpx.Request('POST', 'https://api.openai.com/v1/responses', json={
                    'model':'gpt-5.6-luna', 'reasoning':{'effort':effort, 'context':'all_turns'}, 'max_output_tokens':4096})
                try:
                    check.before(request)
                except ProbeStop:
                    assert bound != 'allowed' and not check.state['requests']
                else:
                    assert bound == 'allowed' and check.state['requests'][0]['reasoning']['effort'] == effort
        assert len(original()) == 4
        print('Fixture has all eight source messages; no network.')
        return
    ledger = load_ledger()
    if mode == 'close':
        ledger.state['status'] = 'closed'
        ledger.save()
        print(json.dumps({k: ledger.state[k] for k in ('status', 'usage_estimated_usd')}))
        return
    assert mode in {'baseline', 'candidate', 'candidate-high', 'pipeline'}
    effort = 'high' if mode == 'candidate-high' else 'medium'
    name = sys.argv[2]
    turns = original() if name == 'original' else CASES[name]
    for line in Path('.env').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').splitlines():
        if '=' in line and not line.startswith('#'):
            key, value = line.split('=', 1)
            if key in {'OPENAI_API_KEY', 'OPENAI_BASE_URL'}:
                os.environ[key] = value.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
    for key in ('LANGSMITH_TRACING', 'LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2', 'LANGCHAIN_TRACING'):
        os.environ[key] = 'false'
    phase = dict(mode=mode, fixture=name, status='running', effort=effort,
        first_request=len(ledger.state['requests'])+1, source_turns=turns,
        prompt=INSTRUCTIONS, prompt_sha256=hashlib.sha256(INSTRUCTIONS.encode()).hexdigest(),
        manual_semantic_review='pending')
    ledger.state['phases'].append(phase)
    ledger.save()
    engine = create_engine('sqlite+pysqlite:///:memory:')
    try:
        with httpx.Client(timeout=120, event_hooks={'request':[ledger.before], 'response':[ledger.after]}) as client:
            model = build_model(model='gpt-5.6-luna', api_key=os.environ['OPENAI_API_KEY'],
                base_url=os.environ.get('OPENAI_BASE_URL'), http_client=client)
            if effort == 'high':
                # Test-only comparison: same provider, prompt, source and cap.
                model = model.model_copy(update={'reasoning': {'effort': effort, 'context': 'all_turns'}})
                ledger.state['effort'] = 'mixed: medium/high, see actual request reasoning'

            reader, ref = source(model, saver, document='ct37-'+uuid4().hex, turns=turns)
            artifacts = MemoryArtifacts(store, reader.document_id, source=reader)
            workflow = ExtractionWorkflow(reader, artifacts, model, saver, max_output_tokens=4096)
            result = workflow.start(ref)
            phase['outputs'] = [{**f, 'summary':artifacts.read_text(f['summary_path']),
                                 'candidates':artifacts.read_text(f['candidates_path'])} for f in result['files']]
            payload = json.loads(ledger.state['requests'][phase['first_request']-1]['input'][1]['content'])
            expected = [{'role':role, 'text':text} for pair in turns
                        for role, text in zip(('user','assistant'), pair)]
            assert payload['NEW_SOURCE']['segments'] == expected
            phase['all_source_messages_exact'] = True
            ledger.save()
            if mode == 'pipeline':
                publication = PublicationStore(engine, artifacts)
                publication.setup()
                b2 = ConsolidationWorkflow(workflow, publication, model, saver,
                    max_model_steps=8, max_tool_calls=12, max_output_tokens=4096)
                state = b2.start()
                current = publication.current()
                phase.update(knowledge=artifacts.read_text('/memory/knowledge.md', current.memory),
                    guide=artifacts.guide(current.memory), revision=current.revision,
                    b2_model_steps=state['used_model_steps'], b2_tool_calls=state['used_tool_calls'])
            phase['status'] = 'completed'
    except Exception as error:
        # Never store arbitrary SDK error bodies or credentials.
        phase.update(status='error', error_type=type(error).__name__)
        if isinstance(error, AssertionError):
            phase['assertion'] = str(error)[:250]
    finally:
        phase['last_request'] = len(ledger.state['requests'])
        ledger.save()
        engine.dispose()
        print(json.dumps({k:phase.get(k) for k in ('mode','fixture','status','error_type','first_request','last_request')},ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

                        assert following > offset and len(pages)<100
                        offset = following
                    check['parts'][part] = pages
                phase['reference_checks'].append(check)
            phase['reference_segments_exact'] = True
            initial = next(p['after'] for p in state['phases'] if p['mode']=='inspect')
            phase['visible_changes'] = {field:list(unified_diff(initial[field].splitlines(),phase['before'][field].splitlines(),fromfile='initial',tofile='final',n=2)) for field in ('knowledge','guide')}
            runner.observations(service, doc, phase)
            assert phase['before'] == phase['after']
            phase['status'] = 'recorded'
    except Exception as error:
        phase.update(status='error', error_type=type(error).__name__)
        raise
    finally:
        OUT.write_text(json.dumps(state,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,default=str),encoding='utf-8')
        print(json.dumps({k:phase.get(k) for k in ('status','original_messages_exact','new_qa_exact','reference_segments_exact')},ensure_ascii=False))


def main():
    if sys.argv[1]=='self-test':
        self_test(); return
    if sys.argv[1]=='audit':
        audit(); return
    if sys.argv[1]=='init':
        assert not OUT.exists(), 'Never reopen an existing trial'
        baseline = json.loads(BASE.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        assert baseline['status']=='closed' and baseline['database']=='q019_ct16_capacity_19d4940b52'
        target = 'q019_ct26_'+uuid4().hex[:10]
        with psycopg.connect(os.environ['Q019_TEST_DATABASE_URL'], autocommit=True) as conn:
            conn.execute(sql.SQL('CREATE DATABASE {} TEMPLATE {}').format(sql.Identifier(target),sql.Identifier(baseline['database'])))
        OUT.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        ledger = CT26Ledger(OUT)
        ledger.state.update(status='running', request_limit=12, usd_limit=.05, phases=[],
            database=target, document_id=baseline['document_id'], text_threshold=None,
            compact_threshold=baseline['compact_threshold'], max_output_bound=baseline['max_output_bound'],
            baseline='3af6466b', fixture_database=baseline['database'],
            fixture_sha256=hashlib.sha256(BASE.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            fixture_kind='CT16 synthetic full database clone; not statistical A/B',
            owner_approval='2026-09-08 owner: OK continue testing; agent bounded this trial to 12 requests / USD0.05, all A/B/SDK attempts',
            reservation_note='Existing short-context guard, >=64K or full bytes x2 at cache-write price plus max output; not exact billing',
            pricing_url='https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing')
        ledger.save()

"""CT-02 owner-approved diagnostic, NOT product logic. 12 POSTs / USD .10.

Actual FastAPI default factory, PostgreSQL, ChatOpenAI, SDK and HTTPS.
Synthetic interview only. Do not persist credentials or opaque reasoning.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import threading
import time
from uuid import uuid4
from unittest.mock import patch

import httpx
import psycopg
from psycopg import sql
from psycopg.conninfo import make_conninfo
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from openai import OpenAIError
from analysis_agent.api import create_app


class ProbeStop(OpenAIError):
    pass


def opaque(items):
    return [{'type': x['type'], 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(x, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
             'encrypted_present': bool(x.get('encrypted_content'))}
            for x in items if x.get('type') in {'reasoning', 'compaction'}]


def visible(items):
    return [x for x in items if x.get('type') not in {'reasoning', 'compaction'}]


class Ledger:
    def __init__(self, output=None):
        self.lock = threading.RLock()
        self.output = output
        self.state = {'model': 'gpt-5.6-luna', 'effort': 'medium', 'request_limit': 12,
            'usd_limit': .10, 'reservation_usd': 0., 'usage_estimated_usd': 0.,
            'pricing_url': 'https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing',
            'requests': [], 'turns': [], 'status': 'starting'}
        self.pending = {}

    def save(self):
        if self.output:
            self.output.write_text(json.dumps(self.state, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')

    def before(self, req):
        with self.lock:
            if req.method != 'POST' or str(req.url) != 'https://api.openai.com/v1/responses':
                raise ProbeStop('Unexpected remote request; no fallback allowed')
            body = json.loads(req.content)
            if (body.get('model') != self.state['model'] or body.get('reasoning') != {'effort': 'medium', 'context': 'all_turns'}
                    or not 0 < body.get('max_output_tokens', 0) <= 4096 or len(req.content) > 80000):
                raise ProbeStop('Probe payload bound')
            # Diagnostic conservative reservation, not an exact tokenizer.
            # Double full serialized bytes at cache-write rate + max output;
            # also reserve at least a 64K input. Count every attempt (SDK retries included).
            reserve = max(64000, len(req.content)*2)*.25/1e6 + body['max_output_tokens']*1.2/1e6
            if (len(self.state['requests']) >= self.state['request_limit']
                    or self.state['reservation_usd'] + reserve > self.state['usd_limit']):
                raise ProbeStop('Approved request/cost boundary reached')
            self.state['reservation_usd'] += reserve
            entry = {'number': len(self.state['requests'])+1, 'reserve_usd': reserve,
                'request_bytes': len(req.content), 'reasoning': body.get('reasoning'),
                'context_management': body.get('context_management'), 'max_output_tokens': body.get('max_output_tokens'),
                'store': body.get('store'), 'truncation': body.get('truncation'),
                'input': visible(body.get('input', [])), 'opaque_input': opaque(body.get('input', [])),
                'tools': [t.get('name') for t in body.get('tools', [])],
                'structured': body.get('text', {}).get('format', {}).get('type')}
            self.state['requests'].append(entry)
            self.pending[id(req)] = (entry, time.monotonic())
            self.save()
            print(f"Request {entry['number']}/{self.state['request_limit']}; bytes={entry['request_bytes']}", flush=True)

    def after(self, resp):
        with self.lock:
            entry, started = self.pending.pop(id(resp.request))
            resp.read()
            entry.update(http_status=resp.status_code, seconds=round(time.monotonic()-started, 2))
            try:
                data = resp.json()
            except ValueError:
                entry['invalid_json'] = True
                self.save()
                return
            entry.update(status=data.get('status'), incomplete_details=data.get('incomplete_details'),
                output=visible(data.get('output', [])), opaque_output=opaque(data.get('output', [])),
                usage=data.get('usage'), service_tier=data.get('service_tier'))
            error = data.get('error')
            if error:
                # Never log arbitrary authentication messages containing a supplied key.
                entry['error'] = {k:error.get(k) for k in ('type', 'code', 'param')}
            usage = data.get('usage')
            if usage and resp.status_code == 200:
                details = usage.get('input_tokens_details') or {}
                cached = details.get('cached_tokens', 0)
                written = details.get('cache_write_tokens', 0)
                cost = ((usage['input_tokens']-cached-written)*.2 + cached*.02 + written*.25
                        + usage['output_tokens']*1.2)/1e6
                entry['usage_estimated_usd'] = cost
                self.state['usage_estimated_usd'] += cost
                self.state['reservation_usd'] += cost - entry['reserve_usd']
            self.save()
            print(f"Response {entry['number']}: HTTP {resp.status_code}, {entry.get('status')}", flush=True)


def self_test():
    ledger = Ledger()
    body = {'model':'gpt-5.6-luna', 'reasoning':{'effort':'medium','context':'all_turns'}, 'max_output_tokens':128}
    for _ in range(12):
        req = httpx.Request('POST', 'https://api.openai.com/v1/responses', json=body)
        ledger.before(req)
        ledger.after(httpx.Response(200, request=req, json={'usage':{'input_tokens':100, 'output_tokens':20}}))
    try:
        ledger.before(httpx.Request('POST','https://api.openai.com/v1/responses',json=body))
    except ProbeStop:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError('13th request escaped')
    ledger = Ledger()
    ledger.state['reservation_usd'] = .099
    try:
        ledger.before(httpx.Request('POST','https://api.openai.com/v1/responses',json=body))
    except ProbeStop:
        assert not ledger.state['requests']
    else:
        raise AssertionError('Cost bound escaped')
    print('Offline ledger checks passed; no network', flush=True)


def main():
    self_test()
    if os.environ.get('PROBE_LIVE') != '1':
        return
    run_id = uuid4().hex[:10]
    out = Path('.test-tmp') / ('native-service-' + run_id)
    out.mkdir()
    ledger = Ledger(out/'result.json')
    database = 'q019_native_' + run_id
    dsn = os.environ['Q019_TEST_DATABASE_URL']
    with psycopg.connect(dsn, autocommit=True) as conn:
        conn.execute(sql.SQL('CREATE DATABASE {}').format(sql.Identifier(database)))
    os.environ.update({'Q019_DATABASE_URL': make_conninfo(dsn, dbname=database),
        'Q019_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS':'90', 'Q019_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS':'4096',
        'Q019_COMPACT_THRESHOLD':'32000', 'Q019_CONTEXT_WINDOW_TOKENS':'1050000',
        'Q019_BACKGROUND_POLL_SECONDS':'2', 'Q019_BACKGROUND_MAX_RECOVERIES':'0',
        'Q019_CONTEXT_BUDGET_MODE':'native', 'Q019_MODEL':'gpt-5.6-luna',
        'LANGSMITH_TRACING':'false', 'LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2':'false', 'LANGCHAIN_TRACING':'false'})
    os.environ.pop('Q019_MEMORY_TEXT_THRESHOLD', None)
    ledger.state.update(database=database, status='running', source_baseline='82ac2266+CT02')
    original = httpx.Client
    class AuditedClient(original):
        def __init__(self, **kwargs):
            hooks = dict(kwargs.pop('event_hooks', {}))
            hooks['request'] = [*hooks.get('request', []), ledger.before]
            hooks['response'] = [*hooks.get('response', []), ledger.after]
            super().__init__(**kwargs, event_hooks=hooks)
    try:
        with patch('analysis_agent.api.httpx.Client', AuditedClient):
            app = create_app()
            with TestClient(app, base_url='http://localhost') as web:
                service = app.state.service
                doc = web.post('/documents', json={'title':'CT02 合成網站接案訪談'}).json()['id']
                ledger.state['document_id'] = doc
                inputs = [
                    '我是接案的前端工程師，依客戶需求開發網站，不是只維護固定網站。A案是餐廳點餐網站，採單次付款；我負責需求訪談、前端實作、串接付款與上線前測試，退款由店長核准。我想透過訪談釐清工作，請先問最重要的問題。',
                    '先補充更正：A案退款是營運經理核准，不是店長，我只排查前端異常。B案是健身房會員網站，採每月訂閱，扣款失敗由財務處理；我的共同工作仍是依需求做前端與串接，上線前我會測正常付款、失敗提示和重複送出。這兩案的付款責任先談到這裡。',
                    '回到剛剛的兩個案子：請簡短回顧共同工作、A案退款由誰核准、B案扣款失敗由誰處理，有不知道的就說不知道。']
                for index, text in enumerate(inputs):
                    if len(ledger.state['requests']) >= 12 or ledger.state.get('failed'):
                        break
                    run_resp = web.post(f'/documents/{doc}/runs', json={'request_key':f'turn-{index}', 'text':text})
                    if run_resp.status_code != 202:
                        ledger.state['failed'] = {'admission_http':run_resp.status_code}
                        break
                    run = run_resp.json()
                    service.join(doc)
                    result = web.get(f'/documents/{doc}/runs/{run["id"]}').json()
                    ledger.state['turns'].append({'input':text, 'run':result,
                        'messages':web.get(f'/documents/{doc}/messages').json()})
                    ledger.save()
                    print(f"Turn {index+1}: {result['status']}", flush=True)
                    if result['status'] != 'completed':
                        ledger.state['failed'] = {'turn':index+1, 'code':result['error_code']}
                        break
                    # Let the existing dispatcher finish a notification, if any.
                    # Short sleeps only in this helper; the parent continues reporting progress.
                    time.sleep(3)
                    deadline = time.monotonic()+180
                    while time.monotonic() < deadline and service.background.status(doc)['status'] in {'running','queued'}:
                        time.sleep(1)
                    ledger.state['memory_status'] = service.background.status(doc)
                current = service._context(doc).memory.publication.current()
                if current:
                    artifacts = service._context(doc).memory.artifacts
                    ledger.state['memory'] = {'revision':current.revision,
                        'knowledge':artifacts.read_text('/memory/knowledge.md', current.memory),
                        'guide':artifacts.read_text('/memory/guide.md', current.memory)}
                ledger.state['status'] = 'stopped' if ledger.state.get('failed') else 'completed_with_limits'
    except Exception as exc:
        ledger.state.update(status='stopped', error={'type':type(exc).__name__,
            'http_status':getattr(exc,'status_code',None)})
    finally:
        ledger.save()
        print(json.dumps({'status':ledger.state['status'], 'requests':len(ledger.state['requests']),
            'usage_estimated_usd':ledger.state['usage_estimated_usd'], 'result_path':str(ledger.output),
            'error':ledger.state.get('error'), 'failed':ledger.state.get('failed')}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
